name: aleph
title: Aleph
description: Aleph from Raycast: your coding-agent sessions (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, …) inside herdr across your ssh machines. See what needs you, open it in Aleph, reply, approve, queue messages, start sessions, install agents and find local LLM servers.
author: aleph

commands.name: sessions
commands.title: Aleph Sessions
commands.description: Every agent session on every machine, grouped by machine: state, folder, task, note, usage limit, live output and queued messages. Open in Aleph, attach in herdr, approve, reply, queue, peek, rename, close.

commands.name: start-session
commands.title: Aleph Start Session
commands.description: Start an agent session (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, …) on any machine. An agent that isn't there installs first (asks).

commands.name: machines
commands.title: Aleph Machines
commands.description: Every machine, live: link, CPU / memory / GPU gauges, its sessions, GPUs, cores, trends, agents, disks, processes and LLM servers. Open in Aleph, Quick Start a session there, run the doctor on it.

commands.name: presets
commands.title: Aleph Presets
commands.description: Saved starting points, one session or a tab of them: launch one, or launch it with changes.

commands.name: doctor
commands.title: Aleph Doctor
commands.description: Aleph's checks — this computer, every machine's ssh, login, herdr and agents, the shortcuts — grouped by section, failures first, with their fixes.

commands.name: send-message
commands.title: Aleph Send Message
commands.description: Prompt a running session now, or when it's free, in a while or at a time.

commands.name: menu-bar
commands.title: Aleph Menu Bar
commands.description: How many sessions need you, then who needs you, who's working, the unread Inbox and your machines, with logos. Refreshes every 30 s, or at once through its deeplink.

commands.name: notification-settings
commands.title: Aleph Notification Settings
commands.description: Who tells you, what the menu bar lists, desktop banners, what reaches your phone (ntfy, Moshi, webhooks) and do not disturb: Aleph's own settings.

commands.name: usage
commands.title: Aleph Usage
commands.description: Tokens, time and cost from the agents' own logs on every machine, for any period (24 hours to 6 months, this week or month, your own dates): the cost under the total by account, agent, machine, model or project; this period against the one before; the week's hours; per prompt and per session; the costliest prompts, tools, plans and insights. From the daemon, or aleph usage.

commands.name: timeline
commands.title: Aleph Timeline
commands.description: What each agent did, conversation by conversation: its prompts, turns, tool calls and subagents, with time, tokens and cost, folded the smart way (repeats as "Read + 7 more"). Open or fold any of it, see the words (read live, never kept).

commands.name: daemon
commands.title: Aleph Daemon
commands.description: Aleph's daemon at a glance: running or not, uptime, the hub and its service; the machines it watches and what it did today; the HTTP API, Tailscale, Cloudflare and paired devices. Start, stop, restart, install; turn the API on; pair a phone or another computer (a link, a code, a QR code).

commands.name: inbox
commands.title: Aleph Inbox
commands.description: What needs you now, then every machine's events and the sessions you started (the old History), by day: needs you, finished, started, ended, unreachable, auto-approved, tasks, restarts, usage limits. Open in Aleph, reply, approve, queue, start again.

commands.name: queue
commands.title: Aleph Message Queue
commands.description: Messages waiting for a session to be free, or for their time: send now, remove, queue again, add one.

commands.name: agents
commands.title: Aleph Agents
commands.description: Each coding agent across your machines: versions, sessions open now, tokens and cost, plan limits. Install a missing one (asks first).

commands.name: llm-servers
commands.title: Aleph Local LLM Servers
commands.description: Ollama, LM Studio, llama.cpp, vLLM, TGI, LiteLLM, … on every machine: health, models loaded, VRAM, where they answer.

preferences.name: binaryPath
preferences.title: Aleph Binary
preferences.description: The aleph binary: a name, looked up in ~/.cargo/bin, /opt/homebrew/bin, /usr/local/bin, ~/.local/bin and then PATH, or a full path. The old name claude-herdr still works.

preferences.name: openWith
preferences.title: Open Sessions In
preferences.description: What opening a session does (↵). Aleph opens it in its Focus view (aleph focus host:name); herdr attaches to it directly. The other one is always the second action (⌘↵).

preferences.name: terminal
preferences.title: Terminal
preferences.description: Where Aleph, attaches, new sessions and installs open, in a new tab (through aleph open-tab, the dashboard's own launcher).

preferences.name: apiUrl
preferences.title: Daemon URL
preferences.description: A daemon on another computer: its HTTP API (https://…, see aleph daemon expose). Empty: this computer's daemon.

preferences.name: apiToken
preferences.title: Daemon token
preferences.description: A device token for that daemon: aleph daemon token new raycast --scope reply

scripts.test: esbuild src/lib/*.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --log-level=warning --outdir=node_modules/.cache/aleph-test && for f in node_modules/.cache/aleph-test/*.test.js; do node "$f" || exit 1; done
